content: पालः .²1 [पाल्-अच्] A protector, guardian, keeper; as in गोपालः, वृष्णिपालः, <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 A herdsman; विवादः स्वामिपालयोः <ls>Ms. 8. 5</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">229</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 8.">240</ls>. .²3 A king; अहो अधर्मः पालानाम् <ls>Bhāg. 1. 18. 33</ls>. .²4 A spitting-pot. .{@-ली@} .²1 A herdsmanʼs wife; <ls>Mb. 5</ls>. .²2 An oblong pond.
